rubric: A dependency upgrade with call-site updates and no behaviour change: a chore, ready (it states how to verify), small or medium. Calling it a feature is wrong. Not urgent: whenever. Backend work. The shared types every package imports: medium risk, not low and not high. It is real work or a real question: not a duplicate, not stale, so the archive suggestion is no.

criteria.kind: Upkeep with no new behaviour: a refactor, dependencies, docs, CI
criteria.ready: Does the issue have testable acceptance criteria an agent could verify without asking anyone?
criteria.size: One function or one file, with its test | Several files in one package
criteria.risk_prelim: Shared code other features depend on
criteria.archive: Should this be archived instead of worked: a duplicate, out of scope, stale, or nothing an agent can act on?
criteria.who: One person, or an internal tool
criteria.what: A rough edge: a workaround exists

reading.why: A dependency bump with call-site changes and no behaviour change: a chore, ready because it states how to verify, backend, small or medium, not urgent, and medium risk because every package imports the shared types.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: bug
ruledOut.why: A dependency upgrade with no new behaviour. It is not: Something that works, or should work, is broken.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: feature
ruledOut.why: A dependency upgrade with no new behaviour. It is not: New behaviour a user or the pipeline can see.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: task
ruledOut.why: A dependency upgrade with no new behaviour. It is not: A defined piece of work with no new behaviour to design: a migration, a rename, a config change.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: question
ruledOut.why: A dependency upgrade with no new behaviour. It is not: It asks for an answer or a decision, not a change.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: incident
ruledOut.why: A dependency upgrade with no new behaviour. It is not: Production is down or wrong right now, data is lost, or a secret is exposed.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: frontend
ruledOut.why: The change is in contracts, a backend package. It is not: Screens, views, keys, rendering, styling.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: infra
ruledOut.why: The change is in contracts, a backend package. It is not: Deploys, CI, containers, cloud or runtime configuration.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: data
ruledOut.why: The change is in contracts, a backend package. It is not: Schemas, migrations, backfills, pipelines, analytics.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: docs
ruledOut.why: The change is in contracts, a backend package. It is not: Documentation or copy only.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: mixed
ruledOut.why: The change is in contracts, a backend package. It is not: Two or more of the above in one change.

ruledOut.question: risk_prelim
ruledOut.label: low
ruledOut.why: Shared types other code depends on. It is not: Isolated code with tests, docs or copy.

ruledOut.question: risk_prelim
ruledOut.label: high
ruledOut.why: Shared types other code depends on. It is not: Auth, payments, data migrations, deletion, CI or infrastructure.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: duplicate
ruledOut.why: It is real work. It is not: Another open ticket asks for the same.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: out_of_scope
ruledOut.why: It is real work. It is not: Not this repository's or team's to do.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: stale
ruledOut.why: It is real work. It is not: Overtaken by events; nobody needs it now.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: not_actionable
ruledOut.why: It is real work. It is not: No change an agent could make or verify.
